lines.say: Do not play these games if you rage easily.
lines.cap: Do NOT play these games if you rage easily.

lines.say: Chaos Climb. One saw blade, and you're back at the start.
Tank Trouble. Your own bullet bounces back, and hits you.
Penalty Shootout. You pick a corner. So does the keeper.
Axe Spin. Hit another axe, and it's over.
And you'll still press play again.
They're all free on Pulsebox. Box dot pulseform dot org. What's your rage game?
